purpose: Current IAMAI visual comparison/reference pack. Canonical HTML continues to own application anatomy; these files own the approved visual skin used for rendered comparison.

logo.$comment: Identity and provenance only. The measurements live once, in the `logo` block at the foot of this file, which is read off iamai-threshold-master.svg. An earlier iteration repeated a DIFFERENT set of numbers here (32-unit panels, a 36-unit gap, y32/y91/y24); those were stale and are removed, because a second copy of a measurement is the thing that lets a redraw look approved.
logo.name: Threshold
logo.geometry: see the `logo` block at the foot of this file

globalRulings.statusPills: primary-text words + semantic dot; state must never be color-only
globalRulings.derivedColors: may derive from core roles but may not introduce independent brand/semantic hues
globalRulings.planCollapsedRows: transparent hairline-separated rows inside phase grouping; opened row becomes the attached surface-backed header

repositoryIntegration.designAuthorityManifestChange: dark name -> Blue Slate; logo direction -> Threshold
repositoryIntegration.rendererRuling: canonical HTML remains anatomy authority; rendered visual comparison target uses the derived approved references
repositoryIntegration.testsNote: tests that byte-pin Deep Mineral or Guided Route must be updated to Blue Slate and Threshold

planOrganization.$comment: The final Plan BOARD organisation authority. It is recorded separately from the `files` hash because its authority is narrow and the boundary is the point: two Plan references are current at once and a later task must be able to read which owns what, as a value rather than by opening both.
owns: collapsed roadmap rows and the column head
Needs attention / Up next focus controls
planOrganization.expandedStepAuthorityNote: The existing Plan reference remains current for expanded-step presentation until the later Plan-step implementation pass. Neither file supersedes the other; they own different halves of the Plan.
planOrganization.exampleDataNote: The file carries design-example counts, dates, phase names and tenant facts. None of them is production data and none may be copied into production: docs/design/content.json remains the copy authority and the engine remains the fact authority.

notYetAuthoritative.$comment: Present in this directory and deliberately NOT recorded as authority yet: it is the later step-family variants pass's input, and recording it now would make it look like something this pass implemented.

logo.name: Threshold
